lines.t: What if a black hole flew past Earth? This Roblox game lets you find out.

full.credit: Clips: What If Disasters (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: What If Disasters came out on October 5th. Every round brings a new disaster on a new map.

full.credit: Clips: What If Disasters (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: Like rain for 1,000 years, or all the water disappearing. Find somewhere safe, and try to survive.

full.credit: Clips: What If Disasters (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)
